descriptions.w3d_d21e_register_table_column_propertie: Resets the ColumnName string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; registers WidthPercent (0x801ec52c); registers Ratio (0x801ec52c); registers Justification (0x801ece2c); registers UnevenColumns (0x801eb674); registers Values (0x801efff0) with a guarded function-local static descriptor built once from a zero-filled temporary; registers Data (0x801efe60) with a guarded function-local static descriptor built once from a zero-filled temporary; calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
